title: Operations Schedule: Added Days for Supplement-Delay Extensions (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Schedule.** For a supplement-delay extension on a Rental Vehicle Coordination insurance rental, the added days are added to the days computed from the extension's supplement. The added days follow the extension's supplement's operations: a supplement adding structural operations adds 2 days; a supplement adding sensor calibrations and no structural operations adds 1 day; any other supplement adds none.

## Records read

Whether the extension's supplement on the insurance claim repair order under Insurance Claim Repairs includes structural operations, and whether it includes sensor calibrations.

## Added days

| Structural operations | Sensor calibrations | Added days |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 2 |
| Yes | No | 2 |
| No | Yes | 1 |
| No | No | 0 |

## Hypothetical cases

- A supplement recorded as including both structural operations and sensor calibrations: 2 added days.
- A supplement recorded as including sensor calibrations only: 1 added day.
- A supplement recorded as including neither: none.
